title: Resolution urging Albany to fund $1,000 baby bonds for kids
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation depositing $1,000 into a state comptroller-managed account for eligible children, to become available when they turn 18. The measure references state Senate Bill S.2187 and Assembly Bill A.4498, which would provide the deposit to children born into households earning $125,000 or less annually. Funds could be used later for purposes such as education, homeownership or entrepreneurship.
